summary: The house style for menu copy, so new dishes match the rest.
content:
Copper Thistle's menu is short and plain. Name the main ingredients and how they're cooked, then stop.

## A simple pattern

Main ingredient, how it's cooked, then what comes with it.

> Grilled hanger steak, hand-cut fries and green peppercorn sauce.

## House rules

- Keep it to one sentence.
- Skip words like "delicious", "mouth-watering" and "world-famous". Let the food do the work.
- Say where something comes from if it's local and it matters.
- List anything a guest would want to know before ordering, such as nuts or shellfish.
- End with a period, so every line on the menu matches.
title: Write a good dish description
author: Sam Keller
